claim_summary: The distinct ternary abelian-border-array counts for lengths 1 through 16 are 1, 2, 4, 9, 20, 49, 119, 308, 795, 2170, 5904, 16702, 47014, 136189, 391967, 1151825, and the complete canonical inverse-fiber histogram at length 16 is supplied. For every length at least two, the all-zero array uniquely maximizes labeled inverse-fiber size at \(3\cdot2^{n-1}\) words.
integrity: Computations were independently regenerated from two different exhaustive enumerators with identical CSV outputs; no independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact census and inverse-fiber distribution are exhaustive only through length sixteen. No general ternary enumeration formula or asymptotic growth is claimed; the extremal ambiguity conclusion is proved for all indicated lengths.
title: Exact ternary abelian-border-array census and reconstruction ambiguity
